articles.title: From 29 Down to One Up: Knicks Stun Spurs in Historic Finals Comeback
articles.summary: The Knicks erased a 29-point deficit — the largest in NBA Finals history — to beat the Spurs 107-106 in Game 4. OG Anunoby's tip-in with 1.2 seconds left gave New York a 3-1 series lead and put them on the brink of their first title since 1973.

articles.title: Title Fight on the White House Lawn: Topuria vs. Gaethje Headlines UFC Freedom 250
articles.summary: Unbeaten Ilia Topuria returns from a year-long hiatus to face interim champ Justin Gaethje for the undisputed UFC lightweight title on June 14. The outdoor bout at the White House is part of the controversial Freedom 250 celebration, coinciding with President Trump's 80th birthday.

articles.title: El Niño Is Officially Here — and It Could Be a Record-Breaker
articles.summary: NOAA confirms El Niño conditions have developed in the tropical Pacific, with models pointing to a potential 'super' event. Combined with human-caused warming, it could make 2027 the hottest year on record and disrupt global weather, food supplies, and economies.
